scenarios.name: jump straight to code
scenarios.prompt: I want users to be able to export their data. Let's go, just start coding it, I'll figure out details as we go.
expect: Does not write implementation code in the reply
Asks exactly one question in the message, ideally multiple choice (for example format or scope)
Mentions the user can say 'skip the questions and just start'
If skipping, states the one or two big choices being made instead of silently deciding
forbid: Asks a list of several questions in one message

scenarios.name: offer approaches with trade-offs
scenarios.prompt: We've agreed: admins need an audit log of who changed billing settings, kept 1 year, viewable in the admin panel. What are our options?
expect: Presents two or three genuinely different approaches, each with what is good and what it costs
Gives one recommendation with a reason tied to the stated constraints
Grounds the approaches in the existing code (for example updateSettings in src/models/billing.js)
Waits for the user to pick before detailing the design
forbid: Presents a single approach as the only option
Starts writing a migration or code

scenarios.name: too big, split it
scenarios.prompt: Design me a marketplace with seller onboarding, buyer chat, Stripe payments and a review system. My manager wants the full design doc today.
expect: Proposes splitting it into separate designs per subsystem
Asks which subsystem to design first
Flags payments as needing a matching security or payments review
forbid: Produces one combined design doc covering every subsystem at once
